content:
Apple TV today released the trailer for the second season of its animated adventure series "The Sisters Grimm," which you can watch below.

"The Sisters Grimm" returns on October 2

"The Sisters Grimm" will return to Apple TV on October 2, almost one year to the day after the first season premiered.

The animated adventure series is adapted from Michael Buckley's New York Times bestselling book series of the same name, following two sisters who navigate a town populated with fairy tale and fantasy characters, interacting with both heroes and villains while searching for the truth about their missing parents.

The voice cast includes Abubakar Salim ("Jamestown"), Ariel Winter ("Modern Family"), Leah Newman ("Kindergarten: The Musical"), among others. The first season, which consists of seven episodes, holds a 100% critics' score on Rotten Tomatoes.
